newsitem.title: EGYPT: Medinet Nasr Q3 96/7 pre-tax soars.
newsitem.headline: Medinet Nasr Q3 96/7 pre-tax soars.

text.p: Egypt's privatised Medinet Nasr Housing and Development more than doubled pre-tax profits for the first nine months of financial year 1996/7 to 156.38 million pounds ($46.06 million) from 68.75 million in the same period of 1995/6.

The firm said in an announcement published on Sunday that the value of its sales fell to 120.92 million pounds from 126.50 million in the first nine months of 1995/6 but total income rose to 131.90 million in 1996/7 from 96.56 million.

The firm's shares are among the most active on the Cairo bourse and closed on Thursday, the last trading day, at 480.00 pounds. The state sold its majority stake in the firm last year for 60 pounds per share.
